title: Canopy Screen IR widget definition
description: One file per IR widget type under screen-ir/widgets/. Holds only the language-neutral contract: the type id and the props it accepts. Editor metadata (palette, inspector) and converter mappings (qtMapping, qtPropMap) live with their tools, not here.

id.description: The IR `type` value. Kebab-case; must equal the filename stem.

version.description: Semver of this definition, release versions only (no pre-release suffix). Bump the major version on an incompatible propSchema change and the minor version on a compatible one, such as a new optional prop.

supportsPv.description: The widget binds a PV through a top-level `pv-channel` prop. False for widgets whose PVs sit only in nested props, such as `waveform-plot` curves.

supportsRules.description: Rules may target this widget's props.

propSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) describing the node's `props`. String props that hold a PV address carry `format: "pv-channel"` (see README). Descriptive in v0.1: not enforced by conformance (see README).
